title: A Night at the Grand Opera: A Giant Puppet Show
description: The North Columbia Schoolhouse is thrilled to welcome String and Shadow’s giant puppet theater to our outdoor amphitheater on August 11th, 2026. The Olympia, WA theater company will join us for one night only on their 2026 west coast tour, featuring their newest production ‘Night at the Grand Opera; A Giant Puppet Show'., String and Shadow’s productions are a wonder to behold, with larger than life sets and puppets crafted from cardboard, fabric, and papier-mache. Their visually stunning performances incorporate music, dance, and circus arts to tell original stories that engage the imaginations of their audiences. You won’t want to miss it!

title: African Drum and Dance of Nevada County
description: Come join our vibrant African Drum and Dance classes! Open to all ages and abilities, we explore different styles from across the African Diasporic disciplines. Including Malian, Congolese, Guinean, Senegalese, Afro-Cuban and Afro-Brazilian. Masters of their craft travel from all over to share their culture and heritage with our beautiful community, along with our own fabulous local teachers and percussionists, to offer a truly inspiring and engaging experience

title: In the Night Dimension and Those We Meet at Twilight
description: Strange beings lurk in pixelated places, eyes peep from dark spaces, and seemingly random objects confront curious travelers. These are the dreamscapes that visitors will encounter in artist Jon Hioki’s new exhibition, In the Night Dimension and Those You Meet at Twilight, opening June 20th at Wonder Docent. The show, which features original paintings and sculptures, will be on display at the downtown Nevada City art supply store through August 16th., Wonder Docent will host an opening reception for In the Night Dimension and Those You Meet at Twilight on Saturday, June 20th from 6 to 8 pm.

title: Night at the Grand Opera: A Giant Puppet Show
description: On August 11th at 7pm the Schoolhouse will have the incredible opportunity of welcoming String and Shadow's giant puppet theater to our outdoor amphitheater. The Olympia, WA theater company will join us for one night of their 2026 west coast tour, featuring their newest production ‘Night at the Grand Opera; A Giant Puppet Show'. , String and Shadow’s productions are a wonder to behold. This theater company really does it all, building larger than life sets and puppets from cardboard, fabric, and papier-mache. Their shows are written to entertain and engage all ages, and showcase a uniquely in-person art form that’s hard to come across in our increasingly digital world. You’ll love it, and you’re not going to want to miss it!, This is an ‘all or nothing’ fundraiser, meaning that if we cannot reach our goal by July 15th, the show cannot go on. , Please consider helping to back this show by purchasing ‘presale’ tickets for the event through our Kickstarter! We recommend a sliding scale donation of $20-$40 per person, which is roughly what a ticket would cost. , If you have more to give and want to ensure that the show will go on, consider a larger donation! If you can't afford a $20 donation, even $5 helps. , Got nothing to give? That’s fine! Tell your friends and loved ones and help spread the word., Once the event is funded, attendance will be ‘free’ and open to the public for everyone to enjoy.

title: Off BroadStreet presents: SHA-LA-LA
description: Starring Tina Marie Kelley, Artemis Arthur, Emily Fitzpatrick & Lindsay Grimes!, In 1984, a wealthy Fresno socialite, a psychologist, a Broadway actress and a high school choir teacher all have one thing in common: while in college in the 1960's, they performed as a vocal quartet known as Sha-La-La. Now, years after going their separate ways, in order to fulfill a fourteen- year-old promise, they must return to their Alma Mater and present a stunning performance of memorable 1960's, ‘70's and ‘80's hits. These lovable ladies will take you on a wonderful, hilarious, uplifting and nostalgic trip through three decades of America’s best music! , Doors open at 6 pm (Fri + Sat) - w/ Musical performances by local acts, Show starts at 7:15 pm, For Sunday Matinee, Doors open at 1 pm Show starts at 2 pm

Saturday Get Behind the Wheel Ceramics
description: Get Behind A Wheel – Pottery Wheel Class for beginners and advanced students with Pam Montalbano, 6 class series – Saturday Mornings, 10:30 am – 12:30 pm, This workshop is for all levels (beginners welcome) who wish to develop and sharpen their pottery-throwing skills on the Potter’s Wheel. We will go over the basics of wedging, centering, pulling, and trimming but also cover how to throw bowls and plates. Everyone is guaranteed to leap a pot. Make that special pot that shows the sudden uptick in your skills. Enjoy playing with clay and making ceramic pottery with your own unique flair. All clay and materials included., Ages: 16+, Price: $216 + $55 materials PUBLIC = $271, Class 4 minimum/8 maximum participants – (please note: if attendance does not meet the minimum, the class will be rescheduled), Pre-registration required.

title: Paint What You Want: A 4-Week Guided Painting Workshop
description: Explore the art of painting in this fun and immersive four-session workshop! Using a simple and effective four-step approach, you’ll learn how to bring any subject to life—whether it’s a portrait, a wildflower-filled landscape, or a captivating still life. Over four weeks, you’ll gain a broader understanding of composition, color, value, and texture, ending the series with a completed painting you’re proud of. Guided by Chappy, you’ll receive personalized instruction tailored to your creative vision.

title: The Creative Labyrinth 102: Filling the Pages
description: Session Two: prerequisite Creative Labyrinth 101, Bring your handmade journal to life in this playful and inspiring follow-up workshop., Using a combination of collage, simple book arts techniques, drawing, painting, writing, and collected imagery, you’ll begin transforming the blank pages of your Australian Hinge journal into a personal creative companion., Participants will explore themes and ideas through intuitive prompts, curated materials, and creative exercises designed to spark curiosity and imagination. Whether you’re creating a nature journal, visual diary, inspiration book, sketchbook, collection of favorite quotes, or something entirely your own, you’ll leave with new pages completed and plenty of ideas for continuing your book at home., No previous art experience is necessary. This workshop emphasizes exploration, experimentation, and creative play rather than artistic perfection., What You’ll LearnSimple methods for developing themes and creative direction, Collage techniques using paper, images, text, and found materials, Basic pocket-making techniques for storing notes, sketches, and treasures, Ways to combine writing, drawing, painting, and collected imagery on the page, Ideas for building an ongoing creative journaling practice, What You’ll CreateSeveral completed journal pages, Handmade pockets and interactive elements, A personalized framework for continuing your journal beyond the workshop, Class Details, Date: Sunday, August 16th, Time: 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM, Ages: Adults & teens 13+, Skill Level: Beginner-friendly, Fee: $75

title: Monday Night Ceramics – Pottery Wheel & Hand building
description: Discover Your Creativity with this Monday Night Ceramics and Pottery Class with Pamela Montalbano, Engage your mind and come play with clay in this Class! In this comprehensive Ceramics and Pottery Class, we will explore both hand-building techniques and pottery wheel skills to create functional and non-functional ceramics and pottery projects. Join us at The Curious Forge and let your creativity flourish in our supportive and inspiring environment!, Class Overview:Hand-Building Techniques: Use slabs, coils, and textures to craft unique ceramic pieces., Pottery Wheel Exploration: Develop and sharpen your pottery-throwing skills on the Potter’s Wheel. We will cover the basics of wedging, centering, pulling, and trimming, as well as how to throw bowls and plates., What’s Included:Clay, glazing, and firings are included in the materials fee., Everyone is guaranteed to complete a pot, showcasing their improved skills., Enjoy making ceramic pottery with your own unique flair., Details:6-class series – Monday Nights from 6:00 – 8:00 PM, All Levels Welcome: This workshop is suitable for beginners and experienced potters alike., Materials: All clay and materials are included., Projects: At least 3 projects will be made in this series., Class Information:Ages: 16+, Price: $216 + $55 materials (PUBLIC) = $271, Participants: Minimum of 5, maximum of 8 (If the minimum attendance is not met, the class will be rescheduled)., Pre-registration required.

title: Stained Glass Curved Cuts- Level 2
description: Take your stained glass skills to the next level! This Level 2 class focuses on mastering curved and inside cuts using the techniques learned in Level 1. You’ll refine your cutting, shaping, and assembly skills while creating a beautiful curved suncatcher approximately 5″ in diameter. Students must be comfortable making straight cuts before taking this class

title: Macrame a Plant Hanger
description: Come relax and create your own beautiful plant hanger! You will learn some of the history behind this historical art while learning basic knots and techniques using soft 100% cotton cords. Macrame is an ancient and calming hands-on art, consisting of a beautiful variety of half knot and square knot patterns. It’s as easy as tying your shoe!

title: STEAM Exploration Saturdays
Watercolor Exploration with Chappy Valente
description: Immerse yourself in the expressive world of watercolor painting! Whether you’re brand new to watercolor or looking to expand your skills, this hands-on class with artist and educator Chappy Valente will help you gain confidence and technique. Learn to paint with fluidity and intention as you explore the tools, papers, and brushwork that make watercolor such a luminous and rewarding medium., Each session is a stand-alone class with fresh projects and techniques—join once or come monthly to continue growing your watercolor practice., What’s the Project:, Create your own watercolor studies exploring washes, color mixing, and texture effects. Each class introduces a new focus—such as landscapes, botanicals, or abstract forms—to inspire your creativity., What Will They Learn:Brush control and paint-to-water ratios, Wash techniques (wet-on-wet, wet-on-dry, gradient), Paper types, brush styles, and pigment selection, Layering, and color blending, Tips for composition and adding expressive detail, Materials Needed:, All materials are provided for in-class use. Students are welcome to bring their own favorite brushes or watercolor set if desired., Skill Level / Prerequisites:, All skill levels welcome—from first-time painters to those continuing their watercolor journey., Class Length:, One 3-hour session, (Optional continuing classes offered monthly), Fee: $50 + $20 materials, Minimum 3 / Maximum 5 participants

title: Rockin' the Gateway presents "Hipper Than Hip"
description: On August 29th it is time to get funky with the hottest horn line this side of Oakland! Hipper than Hip was formed in 2015 with the goal of bringing back the classic sounds of great horn line bands. We drew inspiration mostly from Tower of Power and then added Chicago, Earth Wind and Fire, Aretha, Tina, Stevie, Bruno, and more. If they had a great horn line, and our fans would love it, we wanted to play their music.

title: STEAM Exploration Saturdays
Make your own Hand-Carved Wooden Spoon
description: Hand-Carved Wooden – Spoons and Spatulas (see tickets for project), 3 hours class – , There’s something deeply satisfying about shaping wood with your own two hands., In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll start with a simple block of wood and transform it into a beautiful, functional wooden utensil using traditional hand tools. Under expert guidance, you’ll learn how to safely and confidently use an axe, carving knife, and scoop knife to shape, hollow, and refine your piece., This class is perfect for anyone curious about traditional woodworking or wanting to slow down and experience the rhythm of working with hand tools. No prior experience is necessary — just bring your curiosity and a willingness to learn., By the end of class, you’ll leave with a hand-carved wooden spoon or spatula and the foundational skills to continue carving on your own., What You’ll Create , One hand-carved wooden spoon or spatula (depending on the class ticket you choose), What You’ll Learn, • Safe and proper use of an axe, • Knife carving techniques, • How to use a scoop knife for hollowing, • Foundational greenwood carving skills, Experience Level, Beginners— No experience needed, Ages, Adults, and Teens 13+ may participate when accompanied by an adult., (The accompanying adult may choose to observe or purchase a ticket to participate.), All materials and tools are provided.

title: Drink the Sea
description: Genre: Alternative Rock, Drink The Sea began three years ago in 2022, when Alain and Barrett jammed at Barrett’s studio in Olympia, WA just to see what kind of magic they could conjure together. Two years later, Barrett and Duke toured together in England and Iceland, before recording additional songs in Reykjavik. After that, Barrett, Duke, and Peter met in Sao Paulo to record more songs, which continued with Alain joining them in Joshua Tree, and then some additional recording at Alain’s studio in Santiago, Chile. Final production happened at Barrett’s studio in Olympia, WA, and mixing took place in Barcelona, Spain. The two debut albums the band recorded were literally recorded around the world. , Taking their name from a lyric that Duke wrote, the albums are produced and mixed by Barrett and Alain and reflect the members vast experience as songwriters, arrangers, and singers. It also shows a strong world music influence that permeates the music, because although the songs are built around traditional guitar, bass, and drums configurations, the songs also shimmer with the sounds of Arabic oud, Indian sitar, Indonesian gamelans, and various exotic percussions like Brazilian surdo, frame drum, vibraphone, marimba, and kalimba. , The band will begin touring in October of 2025, and the first single will be released on May 23rd with new singles following every two weeks. The two albums will be released on September 19th and October 3rd, respectively.
